articles.body: If your feed has a cat that stands up on two legs, freezes, lunges sideways and snaps back, then crouches into a back kick and stares at the camera, you have met the Shan Shen Bu cat meme. This post covers where it comes from and the ways I know to get your own cat or dog into it. I built one of the tools below (Shan Shen Bu Cat & Dog AI), so read my entry with that in mind. Where the meme comes from Shan Shen Bu (闪身步, "flash step") started as a folk dance tutorial filmed at the Beijing Dance Academy in the 1990s, with Zhao Tiechun and Ming Wenjun. The stiff stand, the sudden lunge to one side and the snap back is the whole joke. The video went viral again in October 2026, and people began swapping in AI-made animals.

articles.body: A Blueprint for the Smart Boat of Tomorrow The car went from mechanical machine to connected computer in about two decades. Boats are starting the same journey. The connected vessel is a boat that senses its own condition, understands its surroundings, talks to its owner from anywhere, and helps the skipper make better decisions. This article sets out a blueprint for that future and shows which parts of it d3kOS already delivers. 1. Edge Computing: Intelligence Onboard The first rule of marine technology is that the internet is optional . Coverage disappears offshore, in remote anchorages and sometimes a short distance from the marina. So the connected vessel's intelligence has to live on the boat , at the edge: Local data processing. Signal K runs on the onboard Raspberry Pi. Local AI.

articles.title: PGHist | History and audit of table changes in PostgreSQL
articles.excerpt: Hello community! I have developed PGHist — an open-source utility designed for saving, auditing, and viewing table change history in PostgreSQL. 🎯 Target audience: PGHist is specifically tailored for…
articles.body: Hello community! I have developed PGHist — an open-source utility designed for saving, auditing, and viewing table change history in PostgreSQL. 🎯 Target audience: PGHist is specifically tailored for medium-sized projects and low-load tables within larger systems . Fully handles change auditing (log + temporal tables) but focuses primarily on displaying modifications to users. Setting up a trigger-based audit involves creating a schema from one SQL file. Unlike other trigger-based tools that dump massive JSONB deltas (like Logidze or supa_audit), it stores history in a structured, normalized format (row → query → transaction), making it much more convenient to analyze and query data.

articles.title: Before You Animate It: Five Checks for AI Product Images
articles.excerpt: Disclosure: This article is from the RelayMe team. An AI-generated product image can look convincing on its own yet differ from the item a customer will receive. Before turning that image into a video…
articles.body: Disclosure: This article is from the RelayMe team. An AI-generated product image can look convincing on its own yet differ from the item a customer will receive. Before turning that image into a video, compare it carefully with your original product photo. These five manual checks can help your marketing team decide what to keep—and what to reject. 1. Check labels and text Inspect the product name, logo, packaging copy, and any claims or regulatory marks. Look for missing characters, invented lettering, or altered wording. If important text is unreadable or incorrect, do not treat the image as ready for a product page or advertisement. 2. Compare shape and proportions Place the generated image beside your reference. Check the silhouette, lid, handle, taper, and relative dimensions.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 7, 1992: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor, its 1st Mars mission in 20 years at the time, to map the Red Planet like never before
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission, the first Mars mission in 20 years. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission. This was the first mission NASA sent to Mars in almost 20 years! The Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft was an orbiter. It transmitted data from NASA's Mars rovers Sojourner , Spirit and Opportunity back to Earth. The spacecraft also did a lot of its own science. It found surface channels on Mars that appeared to have been created by running water. Mars Global Surveyor looked at the south pole of Mars and saw signs of possible climate change. It also saw a mineral called hematite on Mars. Hematite usually forms in water. NASA then sent its Spirit and Opportunity rovers to look for the hematite, and both rovers found it near their landing sites. Mars Global Surveyor survived much longer than expected.

articles.body: We still may be some time away from sending humans to distant reaches of the solar system, but you can send your name to Saturn's moon Titan, which has the ingredients of life on its surface thanks to NASA's Dragonfly mission. Dragonfly is an SUV-sized nuclear-powered rotorcraft that NASA aims to launch towards Titan in 2028. The agency opened a special events page in late October to allow members of the public to put their name on the spacecraft. The names will be put upon a chip on Dragonfly during the spacecraft's assembly, and all names must be submitted before Jan. 15, 2027. The agency says that the mission has no "ordinary itinerary," as Dragonfly aims to between areas miles (or kilometers) apart after arriving on the surface in 2034.

articles.excerpt: The movies might be struggling to recapture the magic, but Star Wars video games are strong with the Force.
articles.body: After a tumultuous start to EA's rebooted Star Wars Battlefront series, in 2021 Lucasfilm and Disney decided to open up the development of new Star Wars games by bringing in different publishers and studios under the Lucasfilm Games banner. Now, over five years on, we can confidently say we're entering a new golden era of amazing Star Wars games . With LucasArts' successor calling the shots and coordinating a multitude of projects set in a galaxy far, far away, even EA's latest efforts like Squadrons and the Jedi series have taken bigger and bolder swings. Now, in 2026, the full potential of the Star Wars universe has become clearer with specific releases squarely aimed at niche audiences.

articles.title: 'I think we will prevail': NASA chief Jared Isaacman on Artemis, China and the new moon race (exclusive)
articles.excerpt: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman during a a Dec. 3, 2025 confirmation hearing. In October of 2026, Isaacman sat down with Space.com to discuss the future of the space agency.
articles.body: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman is serious about launching "big rockets" to the moon every single year for the agency's Artemis program. And the new space race with China is fueling that ambition. "I feel good. I feel like we are certainly on a more achievable path to the lunar surface today than where we were before," Isaacman told Space.com. We recently sat down with the NASA chief to discuss the state of the Artemis program , and, off the bat, he made it clear that he's confident in the U.S. space program following the success of April's Artemis II mission around the moon. In fact, just prior to our conversation, it was announced that Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman will become the new deputy director of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
